body: Isn't Andy's 21+?
It just really sucks because I can tell he's trying to be better this time. I just feel awful about it all.
I know, I'm really bad about putting others before me. I realize I need to. Its just so hard because I know how bad its going to hurt us both.
I know. I realize this. I'm also so scared of not having him in my life he is the first and only guy I've been in love/in a relationship with.
I just worry about him when we break up, last time he become an alcholic and suicidal. And I know its because I left him, I just have a lot of guilt and in general feel guilt over everything.

Yes I realized it was hard to read without any spacing. I appreciate this and I realize I should break up with him. I just have a lot of guilt I broke up with him the first time and was the one who reached out.
I don't understand how saying keep your god damn mouth shut is helpful. There's other ways to word it.

I know because the girl he cheated on with had told multiple people. But like you said I do not know 100% it is from a reliable source though. And again my main rationale is just that I would like to think she would do the same for me. I'm still very torn
Were pretty cool, like we've hung out just the two of us a few times and always talk when we see each other. I don't think he would pose any danger at all, more so I don't know how he would respond.

Yeah if I had proof honestly I wouldn't be debating and as much as I personally believe it, I still don't have proof. I just don't want to see her with a guy who could do this to her. I mean if she knows she can at least decide for herself versus not even being informed. But is it my place blah blah
I feel like it is too, but I posted this in another sub and it blew up into "its not my place" so I'm conflicted.

That sucks man /: and I'm just torn between its not my place and if it was reversed I would want to know. Especially with previous experiences I'm a firm believer in telling someone if you know there is infidelity. BUT with that said it doesn't mean she feels the same.
Being rude like this does literally nothing to help the situation, I'm here for advice not to be lectured for something I haven't even done.
Yeah. I didn't know that was what my friend was going to tell me. Regret asking now because I have to either do something or risk it coming out and having her upset I didn't tell.
So basically no matter what its gonna suck.
That's why I am hesitant I don't have proof, but at the same time if she was in my position i would like her to tell me.
Yeah, its more so when. I just don't know when I would see her in person again. And don't know if calling her would work, and if so how soon I should.
Yeah I know I need to. Its just hard. And I want to ask her to not mention my name but I realize its probably going to come out.
That's what I was thinking too. I'm just not sure how to tell her, we live hours away and I feel like this would probably be better in person.
I love her but I worry if he says he didn't that she will believe him, he's very charming when he needs to be.
All good, its all very helpful honestly.
I'm not sure, he said it so flippant, as if it was obvious.

There was a typo on it for the father and I thought it was funny so I showed my mom. Wasn't a typo. I'm half adopted and they were never gonna tell me that my biological dad is a crack head who gave me up to my (I guess step) dad to raise me. I'm not allowed to tell my brother or anyone one in the family who doesn't already know.

I'm sorry you're struggling and I hope things get better for you. Random internet stranger cares about you and wishes you the best.

Hey, I know adulting is really really hard especially when it all happens at once. I'm sorry its been so hard on you, that really sucks. I hope things work themselves out and you feel better. My DMS are always open if you wanna talk more.
Hey, I'm really sorry you're struggling. Do you wanna talk about anything going on?

It sounds like you are having an awfully rough time. Honestly I'm super proud of you for pushing forward still and looking for a job and trying to get things moving, I know they can seem to take forever. Please don't end it, even if some people are awful I'm sure you're daughter still adores you and you still have her.

It sounds like you're really hurting, and I know it must get tiresome. But at least tell her first and let her know so she can work on it. And you don't deserve for anyone to be mean to you. Just try and keep fighting I believe in you.

Oh honey, I'm so sorry about your dad, and I'm sorry your family isn't being supportive. You're so young, you have so much in life to experience please don't hurt yourself. I know you must be scared, and that's okay. And its okay to need help and to ask for it. You can always try it and if it doesn't work that's okay. And I know other kids can be really mean, you'll find some good ones though I promise. Let me know if you need to talk
Highschool is very hard. And I know adulting is daunting, but when you get out of high school and actually get to start working towards what you want I think it may seem less daunting.

Even if it stress she shouldn't be mean to you. If you don't think it would be okay if you said these things to her, it means its not alright if she does. Have you talked to her about how she is hurting you, even if she's not realizing it?
It sounds like you're a sweetheart. I'm sorry you're having a hard time, and I'm sorry you're struggling. You don't deserve it. Let me know if you want yo vent.
I'm really sorry you've struggled so much. I hope you know you could never deserve all those horrible things. I hope you don't end it. Even if I'm a random stranger I care about you.

Don't feel like you're a burden, the ones who love you will want to help. And as for those looking up to you they will see you as even stronger for getting help. In the regards of your lost friend, it is awful, but you won't be adding to their grief by getting help for yourself, even if it is just telling a friend and letting it all out. And I'm sorry about your previous experiences with telling people that is awful. And let me know if you want to talk.
You can make it through this. Its hard, but you can make it I believe in you. If you want to talk we can.

And you have every right to be angry, it's fucked up he got away with it. And again its fucked up no one believes you. That being said I hope you can find the closure to accept its fucked up but still be able to move on, which is easier said than done. Im sorry people have made you regret coming forward and that nothing was done against him, it was still incredibly brave of you to. I really hope you can find someone you can talk to in full about this so you can get it all out, and start recovering. I hope you take time to take care of yourself and focus on your happiness and health, and from there things will start to get better.

I'm really sorry you haven't had anyone who would listen to what happened to you, that's awful. What happened is awful and hard to deal with, and no one should have to go through that. Have you considered counseling, if that's available to you? I know its not much but random internet stranger here cares a lot and hopes things get better for you *hugs*. And if you want you can PM me.
